title: Convent of the Capuchos (Sintra)
scope: The surviving Franciscan Convent of the Capuchos in the Serra de Sintra, including its low rock-integrated rooms, nearby stone chapels and granary, the fountain courtyard and immediate approach.
limitations: Roof subdivisions, retaining stone sizes, doors and hermitage heights are approximate. The exterior layout follows the named mapped buildings.
Cloister furnishing positions, granite boulders and the main entry steps are reconstructed from oblique photographs and the terrain. The small rooms are modeled from their visible exterior.
